authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sequential/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sequential/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN tables, on its number, with its printed range and name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Values go out as the manual prints the format: NRPN MSB/LSB on CC 99/98, value MSB/LSB on CC 6/38. The instrument must have its Global MIDI parameter receive set to NRPN (or All).
1 parameter(s) the manual marks as transmitted but ignored when received are read-only.

Left out, printed without a range: NRPN 4 (Osc 1 Freq MSB), 6 (Osc 2 Freq MSB), 28 (Filter Cutoff MSB), 84 (Scale), 89 (Name 1), 90 (Name 2), 91 (Name 3), 92 (Name 4), 93 (Name 5), 94 (Name 6), 95 (Name 7), 96 (Name 8), 97 (Name 9), 98 (Name 10), 99 (Name 11), 100 (Name 12), 101 (Name 13), 102 (Name 14), 103 (Name 15), 104 (Name 16), 105 (Name 17), 106 (Name 18), 107 (Name 19), 108 (Name 20), 109 (Editor Byte), 110 (Arp On), 119-126 (Seq1_RestFlags1 -8), 127-134 (Seq2_RestFlags1-8), 135-142 (Seq3_RestFlags1-8), 143-150 (Seq4_RestFlags1-8), 151-158 (Seq1_TieFlags1-8), 159-166 (Seq2_TieFlags1-8), 167-17 (Seq3_TieFlags1-8), 175-182 (Seq4_TieFlags1-8), 183-246 (Seq1_Note1-64), 247-310 (Seq2_Note1-64), 311-374 (Seq3_Note1-64), 375-438 (Seq4_Note1-64), 439-502 (Seq1_Vel1-64), 503-566 (Seq2_Vel1-64), 567-630 (Seq3_Vel1-64), 631-694 (Seq4_Vel1-64), 695-702 (Seq1_GlideFlags1-8), 703-710 (Seq2_GlideFlags1-8), 711-718 (Seq3_GlideFlags1-8), 719-726 (Seq4_GlideFlags1-8).
